spec.join: _burnin_arm_cells harvests every numeric column a burn-in face publishes; a cell present on one side only is reported, and a cell moved is reported with its pointer
spec.control: the same arm joined against itself; every cell must read delta 0.0 or the join machinery moved the numbers

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.reading: the burn-in conclusion survives the repair: all 20 gate columns and every gate date are unchanged; 13 of 36 return cells move, worst 0.42 pp

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking

the screened arm repairs prints *inside* the panel it is handed; it does not change which bars are missing, so an unchanged eligibility count is a property of the repair, not evidence the data is clean
a same-arm control is run in-round and published; a non-zero control invalidates the pair regardless of how the deltas read
one burn per runner: burnin/e44/knife/skinloo share run_burnin, so this ticket re-derives the burn-in face only; knife and skinloo keep their own tickets
